details: Camelot-ammv2-core@1.0.0 runs a credential-harvesting script in both its preinstall and postinstall hooks (node index.js). The script enumerates all environment variables whose names match KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASS/PRIVATE/MNEMONIC/RPC/AWS/GITHUB/NPM/KUBE/VAULT/AUTH/PGP/GPG/SEED/WALLET, reads the installer's ~/.npmrc and ~/.gitconfig, and lists the contents of ~/.ssh, ~/.foundry/keystores, ~/.config/hardhat, and ~/.config/gcloud. It then POSTs all collected data as JSON to hxxps://webhook[.]site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09. Errors are silently swallowed so the install never fails. The package impersonates the Camelot AMM protocol to harvest wallet keystores and credentials.
